subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR wait for real embedded-agent proof of the internal-handoff drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths before merge, or should maintainers choose the broader open repair candidate instead?
rationale: The repository requires real behavior proof for external PRs, and this diff changes session-state prompt semantics that focused helper tests and green CI do not fully settle.

options.title: Require runtime proof here
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording show internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly accept the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Prefer the broader candidate
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical repair path for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof here
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording show internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in the April merged repair.
